_note: Parts 3 and 4 are the two black triangular gussets bolted to the top of the shell, either side of the pole hub — visible in the reference photo. They are shell, not chassis, so they spin with it; they were in body and stood still while the dome turned under them. Part 5 (the bearing flange at the dead centre) and part 8 (the self-righting pole) stay in body: the pole does not rotate, which is the whole point of it.
